Rendering occurs only inside the selected geometric object's volume.
If Fire Lights are enabled, only those inside the cutter are rendered.
**Invert Cutter** (`invgizmo`): When enabled, rendering occurs only outside the render cutter.
Rays not intersecting the cutter are shaded.
**Steps**: Partition the volume data using slab decomposition.
Volume render each data slab to generate a set of prerendered source images.
A method to intermix opaque and translucent geometry with volumetric data by interlacing slab images.
**Steps**: For opaque polygons: Render geometry into the framebuffer, then draw slab images with z-depth test to correctly occlude volume samples behind the geometry.
